svg.desc: As of 2026-10-24. 25 supplied binaries: DrvMgt.dll, Game.exe, IJoy.dll, INet.dll, LS3DF.dll, Setup.exe (supplied configuration), binkw32.dll, ogg.dll, rw_data.dll, vorbis.dll, vorbisfile.dll, Setup.exe (archive installer bootstrap), SLUS_206.71, CDVDSTM.IRX, IOPRP271.IMG, LIBSD.IRX, MCMAN.IRX, MCSERV.IRX, MTAPMAN.IRX, PADMAN.IRX, SDRDRV.IRX, SIO2MAN.IRX, SOUND.IRX, SOUND2.IRX, SOUND_M.IRX. Per-binary static retained pseudocode and absolute scoped Rust entries are separate measures. N/A means no measured static ratio. PS2 linker symbols provide naming evidence only. 309 reviewed scoped entries across 113 contracts. Strict full-system verification: 0 of 12; not a game-completion percentage.
